name: Full Server Fix VIP
description: VIP variant of Full Server Fix: when the server is full and a joining account carries the VIPFlag, an AFK player is ejected to free a slot instead of the joining client being dropped.
loadOrderNote: Supersedes LiF-x/FullServerFix and should not be installed alongside it: FullServerFix drops a full-server connection at onPreConnectRequest, which pre-empts this mod's onPostConnectRoutine idler-eviction. Loads at 200 because it inspects other connected clients' state and alters the server-full behaviour.
